findings.text: the census asks, for each value, for three deciding-source figures plus the undecided figure summing to 1,766, while the declared negative control requires a signal whose sources disagree to be "recorded as a conflict and counted, not resolved silently"; a conflict is neither decided by a source nor a signal "no source decides", so with any such signal the sum is either short of 1,766 or absorbs a conflict into a bucket the section defines against it
